outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished 2D RPG game environment background, one fixed playable node
Input images: Image 1 is a style, palette, camera, and world-continuity reference only; generate a new location rather than editing it.
Primary request: Lumenwood Crossing, an enchanted twilight forest immediately beyond Moonroot Hollow. A broad luminous root-and-moss trail enters at bottom center, opens into a generous oval clearing across the lower and middle image, then leads to a clearly readable ancient root arch at upper center that serves as the next exit. A single distinctive star-seed flower glows pale gold and violet beside the left-middle edge of the walkable clearing, visibly reachable as a quest landmark. Include one shallow circular moonwater basin near the right-middle edge as environmental continuity, without blocking the route.
Style/medium: match Image 1's richly hand-painted whimsical fantasy RPG illustration, soft storybook brushwork, tactile bark and moss, silver-blue moonlight, amber window-like firefly glows, violet accents.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape; same fixed elevated three-quarter game camera as Image 1; one simple elevation; wide unobstructed walkable floor from bottom entry through the clearing to the upper root arch; strong readable silhouettes and navigational landmarks; background fills the whole canvas.
Lighting/mood: blue-violet dusk, inviting mystery, luminous spores and restrained warm accents.
Constraints: no player character, no people, no creatures, no UI, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark; no cliffs, stairs, bridges, or ambiguous overlapping elevations; do not place branches, foreground foliage, props, or effects across the central walk lane; keep all scene art baked into one opaque raster background suitable for direct use in a Godot Sprite2D; preserve the exact camera logic and visual language of Image 1 without copying its town composition.
